title: KeePassXC configuration
whyItMatters: KeePassXC keeps its settings and recent-database list in this folder. It shows an offline password manager was used and which database files were opened.
source: KeePassXC User Guide, User Settings Locations: %AppData%/KeePassXC/keepassxc.ini - https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_UserGuide
notes: Roaming configuration only. The .kdbx databases can be stored anywhere and are not searched; local state may also sit under %LOCALAPPDATA%/KeePassXC. The INI file is never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Make sure every KeePassXC database you need is backed up elsewhere and you know its master password and key file.
steps: Uninstall KeePassXC from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the KeePassXC settings folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes KeePassXC settings and the recent-databases list. Database files are not touched, so keep your own backup.
cleanup.source: KeePassXC User Guide, User Settings Locations: https://keepassxc.org/docs/KeePassXC_UserGuide
